title: interruptible-quarantine-and-slo-compaction-bridge
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: In recent region surge incidents we observed frequent circuit flips and aggressive tenant eviction spikes when health probes and SLO scoring converge during bursty ingress. That behaviour amplified recovery time because short-lived noisy failures triggered hard quarantines and large SLO penalty accruals. This PR introduces an interruptible quarantine window and an SLO compaction bridge aimed at reducing oscillation while preserving fair shedding for overloaded tenants.

What this changes (single continuous description): Adds an interruptible quarantine controller that marks a node/tenant as 'soft-quarantined' for a configurable window (default 30s) during which eviction is interruptible by sustained healthy probes and KV-drain progress; introduces an SLO compaction step which caps incremental SLO penalty accrual per-tenant to a smoothing function over a sliding window (configurable, default 5m) to avoid runaway penalty spikes; adds a bridge in the load-shed decision path that blends hard eviction signals with the new soft-quarantine state to prefer gradual eviction and KV-prefetch-affine throttling instead of immediate hard disconnection.

Key motivations: reduce cross-region failover churn, prevent collateral tenant evictions from transient probe noise, provide an operational knob to trade short-term SLO strictness for stability during known region-level capacity events.

Implementation summary: changes in services/slo-manager: new interruptible_quarantine.go controller and compaction policy implementation; runtime/shedder: decision path updated to consult QuarantineBridge and to allow staged eviction with TTL-backoff; sequencer: small backpressure hook to surface kv-drain progress for interrupt logic; config: feature flag slo_compaction.enable and parameters under runtime.features.slo_compaction; tests: unit tests for compaction math and e2e stability test that simulates probe flapping.

Behavioral notes and knobs: the feature is off by default. When enabled it introduces three knobs: quarantine_window_seconds (default 30), slo_compaction_window_seconds (default 300), and max_penalty_delta_pct_per_window (default 20%). Operators can tune via the runtime config map or via the Console feature toggle.

Rollout plan: 1) Canary in eu-west-1 for low-traffic tenant cohort (2% traffic) for 2h, 2) expand to regional pool for 24h while monitoring slo_burn, circuit_state_flip_rate, and tenant_eviction_rate, 3) full rollout if metrics are stable (<10% change to user-visible latency and <5% change to permanent_eviction_rate). Rollback is a single flag flip.

Testing & verification: added unit coverage to slo-manager (compaction math), added integration harness scenario that replicates probe noise; ran a 2-hour canary window during which circuit flips dropped by 42% and permanent evictions dropped by 31% in simulated bursts (see commits for logs).

Related: references SUP-2041 root-cause and ENG-1284 followup investigation.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation compiled and unit-tested - [x] Integration test added to perf-canary harness - [x] Feature-flag gating and Console toggle wired - [x] Rollout/monitoring doc added - [x] Post-merge incident watch scheduled
commits:
1) feat(slo-manager): add interruptible quarantine controller and compaction policy
2) feat(runtime): QuarantineBridge path and staged-eviction logic
3) fix(sequencer): expose kv-drain progress metric for interrupt checks
4) test: unit + integration scenarios for compaction and flapping probes
5) docs: runbook and console toggle wiring
review_comments: Marco Li: Can we keep the default compaction window at 5m? If customers have very bursty traffic it could hide real regressions. Suggest adding a circuit flip counter override for critical tenants.
Aisha Kapoor: Agree on the concern. Kept default 5m but added max_penalty_delta_pct_per_window and an override for tenants labeled 'critical' to bypass compaction. Added note in runbook.
Elena Martinez: CI failed on integration first run due to a mock time dependency — please avoid global time.Now() in tests.
Aisha Kapoor: Addressed — switched to injected clock in tests and runtime. Pushed fix in commit 4.
Jonah Price: Approved after the clock fix and adding a short e2e canary in eu-west-1. Leaving a follow-up to add dashboard panel for 'quarantine_interrupt_rate'.
merge_result: Merged by Elena Martinez on 2025-03-15 via squash merge. Merge commit message: 'hotfix(slo): interruptible quarantine + compaction bridge — reduce eviction churn on regional surges'. Backout plan documented in docs/runbooks/slo-compaction.md.
release_notes: Introduce interruptible quarantine and SLO compaction bridge to reduce eviction and circuit-flip churn during short-lived region surges. Feature gated and off by default. Operators can enable via runtime.features.slo_compaction and tune quarantine_window_seconds, slo_compaction_window_seconds, and max_penalty_delta_pct_per_window.
